q: Is this an AI trading algorithm or human-led macro research?
a: Our Pro research is human-led, with manually curated macroeconomic views, financial headlines, weekly plans and market recaps. The team uses AI-assisted tools to bring together company research, publicly disclosed insider transactions and hedge-fund holdings, unusual options volume, earnings and events such as index inclusion. These tools help us review more evidence and identify details that could otherwise be overlooked; people interpret the findings and develop the research views. We use public information, not confidential insider information. Filings can lag trades, and we cannot know a fund’s future trades or announcements in advance. Heavy insider selling can inform a bearish scenario, but it does not by itself establish that a stock will fall or that a put option will be profitable. Returns and win rates are not guaranteed.

q: What are the best AI growth stocks to watch right now?
a: There is no universal best stock. Start with companies whose business you understand, compare growth with valuation, and consider risks and your time horizon. Our company research pages organize evidence and recent headlines; inclusion is not a buy recommendation. The founder’s research approach combines macroeconomic analysis, company fundamentals and data science. See Aness Hussein Ali’s founder profile for his reported professional background and links; former employers do not endorse the service.

q: How does Stocks To Buy Now AI calculate market signals?
a: The app brings together company metrics, market context and analytical tools. This website does not publish a complete validated scoring formula. Signals should be assessed with their assumptions and risks rather than treated as certain outcomes.

q: Why did a stock rise or fall today?
a: Check a timestamped quote, company announcements, earnings guidance and sector performance. Several factors may contribute. A headline occurring near a price move does not by itself prove the cause.

q: Are the stock quotes and predictions on this website live?
a: Archived research carries its original date. A live quote must have a data source, timestamp and market-session label; an unlabeled screenshot is not a live quote. Forecasts are uncertain and are not guaranteed prices.

q: What is available publicly and what requires the app?
a: Public pages provide company research guides, article previews, a glossary and any separately published full articles. Subscription research and additional app tools remain available in the app.
